{{Quote|Garqi Eagles, you are clear to intercept and destroy your target.|[[Mosh Barris/Legends|Mosh Barris]]|<ref name="Missed Chance">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}</ref>}}
The '''Garqi Eagles''' were an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] based on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. Four fighters from this squadron were destroyed by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] during the [[Great Evacuation|escape]] of the ''[[Star's Delight]]'' from Garqi in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="Missed Chance" />
